Census @ef571276 (source identical to a8cf23f8: only records/ changed between them; re-derive any count below if a listed path changed since). Realize the architect position in mav's own declarations (packages/canon/src/agents/mav.ts). Operator ruling (note 'named personas and generic positions'): kino, nico and mav are main-session personas, each with its own specialty and personality over the architect role, and each speaks only the architect position; the generic `architect` is the subagent-oriented holder. Holders override scalars and EXTEND sets (roles/hold.ts), so what the role unit changes reaches here, and what the holder declares itself only this unit can fix. mav stays distinct from the generic architect by its persona: its own voice, mark and maintenance register.
CHANGE. Drop the `framing: goalDirected` override: 'goal-directed ⟨shortest viable path · analysis ↾ delivery⟩' subordinates analysis to delivery, and the role's systems-thinking holds (goal-directed.ts stays in the catalog). Archetype: cut 'Serves the operator's intent over their literal words, decides every in-remit call itself, and reserves for the operator only what is genuinely theirs …', which restates principal-self and mission-command, both projected by the role, and any clause casting mav as answering for a delivery rather than for the design realized. State that an assay is a second description in the design's own words, which is what separates it from a report (both Opus reads left 'Judges assays, never artifacts and never reports' UNCLEAR on that difference). Description: restore 'for planners' after cutting the design, and add checks and merges to the integrator among the hand-offs. Comments: 7-11 state the operator ruling (mav the named persona, `architect` the subagent-oriented holder); 13-19 quote the role contract as architect-role leaves it; 21-26 drop the goal-directed defence and "`delivery` needs no override"; 28-33 (history of the retired structured-decision) cut. For each architect holder build the text its session starts with: $T/agents/<h>.md whole (front matter and hooks included), then each skill of its `skills:` list in order, as $T/skills/<s>/SKILL.md with its front matter stripped. Give each text, with no other context and no tools, to two distinct models (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 and anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5, the pair the assay of 20961057 used) with this prompt verbatim: 'Below is the complete definition of an AI agent and the skills loaded into it at session start. (b) Does it itself run code, tests, builds or checks? (c) Does it itself make commits? (d) Does it itself merge work into main? (e) Does it itself read code or produced artifacts? (f) Does it itself read the reports or returns of the agents it delegates to? (g) To whom, by name, does it hand planning, building, reading what landed, and running checks and merging?' Save every prompt and answer verbatim under /tmp/architect-position-cold-read/mav-position/ and return the paths; print the number of reads taken (8 = 4 holders x 2 models).
